title: Voice: a misheard word MAIN must re-interpret ('delete' reaches the box as 'delight'), in a noisy kitchen

seed.notes/test_notes.py:
import notes


def test_add_and_list(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(notes, "PATH", str(tmp_path / "n.json"))
    notes.add("milk")
    notes.add("eggs")
    assert notes.list_notes() == ["milk", "eggs"]

personas.persona: A developer cooking dinner, phone on the counter, talking hands-free over a noisy kitchen. Casual, short sentences. Believes the speech recognition hears them fine.
goals: Your little notes tool lives in the notes folder (you can say so). Get a delete command added to it — delete a note by its number — with a pytest test.
If main asks what you meant, answer briefly. If main builds something other than a delete command, correct it.
In the end you want to hear that the delete command works and the tests pass.
script: First turn: ask to add a delete command to the notes tool in the notes folder, deleting a note by its number, with a test.
Wait for main to come back; answer any question briefly.
When it says it's done, ask in a few words how it was tested, then finish.

checks.name: notes tests pass
checks.cmd: cd notes && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

voice_checks.name: the mishearing reached the box (it heard 'delight')
